maintenance.oilLifeResetInstructions: Switch the ignition on without starting the engine. Press the accelerator and brake pedals at the same time and keep both fully pressed. After about 3 seconds a message confirms the reset is in progress; after about 25 seconds a message confirms it is complete. Release both pedals and switch the ignition off. Reset only after changing the oil and filter. (Ford owner's manual, Oil Change Indicator Reset.)
